card.name: Inside capitalized words before O
card.fires_on: The last piece of an all-caps medical word just before an 'O' piece begins, such as BRON-CH before OSPASTIC, or VENO- before OCCLUSIVE. Mostly in uppercase warning headings.

modes.label: BRONCH before OSPASM
modes.description: The CH piece in uppercase BRONCHOSPASTIC or BRONCHOSPASM in warnings.

modes.label: Other words joined before O
modes.description: A piece or hyphen right before an O-starting piece in other uppercase terms.

card.writes: It pushes the model toward an upcoming piece that begins with a capital O and away from pieces starting with ob, oc or og.
card.plain: It fires in the middle of an all-caps medical word when the next piece will start with the letter O, like BRONCH-OSPASM.
